GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-11-16T08:50:15Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Exception when clicking on a chart in version 2.4.0
Description: Hi all !

When I click on a chart the following exception is raised:
> core.umd.js:3376 TypeError: Cannot read property 'intersect' of undefined
>     at Object.dataset (Chart.js:6252)
>     at Chart.Controller.getDatasetAtEvent (Chart.js:4418)
>     at UIChart.onCanvasClick (chart.ts:57)
>     at _View_UIChart0._handle_click_3_0 (UIChart.ngfactory.js:63)
>     at eval (core.umd.js:9602)
>     at eval (platform-browser.umd.js:1716)
>     at eval (platform-browser.umd.js:1829)
>     at ZoneDelegate.invoke (zone.js:232)
>     at Object.onInvoke (core.umd.js:6158)
>     at ZoneDelegate.invoke (zone.js:231)

Indeed it appears that no check is made with the parameter _**options**_ of function _**dataset**_:
```
dataset: function(chart, e, options) {
   var position = helpers.getRelativePosition(e, chart.chart);
   var items = options.intersect ? getIntersectItems(chart, position) : getNearestItems(chart, position, false);
  ...
}
```
**_Options_** is undefined because it is not input as parameter when calling **_dataset_**:
```
getDatasetAtEvent: function(e) {
     return Chart.Interaction.modes.dataset(this, e);
},
```
So one fix should be to check if options is defined like this:
```
var items = options && options.intersect ? ...
```
What are you thinking about ?
